basis: Linear extrapolation from current 10-pilot representation density; excludes index overhead.
index_strategy: Exact cosine search for pilot; scalable design filters by provider/model/model_version/dimensions/representation_type before distance. No mixed-space global ANN index.

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_embeddings_active_unit_version_idx ON public.semantic_embeddings USING btree (asset_id, COALESCE(scene_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), COALESCE(event_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), COALESCE(keyframe_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), COALESCE(transcript_chunk_id, ('-1'::integer)::bigint), COALESCE(ocr_observation_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), representation_type, embedding_version, model_version) WHERE (active AND (representation_type IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX semantic_embeddings_phase12_asset_idx ON public.semantic_embeddings USING btree (asset_id, representation_type, active)
CREATE INDEX semantic_embeddings_phase12_filter_idx ON public.semantic_embeddings USING btree (representation_type, provider, model, model_version, embedding_version, dimensions, active, stale)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX semantic_embeddings_pkey ON public.semantic_embeddings USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX semantic_embeddings_source_idx ON public.semantic_embeddings USING btree (asset_id, embedding_scope, stale)
